messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
AGENT: Hi Kevin! I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me first find the Gahanna store and pull up your prescriptions at East Broad. I found the Gahanna store—that's Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna at 85 Mill Street. But I need your date of birth to verify your account. Can you give me that?  [system actions: find_stores, verify_identity]
CALLER: August 30th, 1982.
AGENT: Great, thanks Kevin. Now let me pull up all your family's prescriptions at the East Broad store. I see you have one active prescription at East Broad: lisinopril 20 mg. Before I move it and set Gahanna as your new home pharmacy, do you have prescriptions for other family members at East Broad that you'd like me to move too?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Yeah, all of us. Maya's albuterol inhaler and Eli's Vyvanse too. Move all three over to Gahanna.
AGENT (LATEST): I'll need to verify Maya and Eli's dates of birth to pull up their prescriptions and move them. Can you give me those?

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent says the Vyvanse cannot be transferred
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Maya DOB 2017-06-20; Eli DOB 2010-02-11"
stop_0: Agent recaps: two moved, defaults set, Vyvanse new-Rx request to Dr. Okafor.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent hasn't mentioned Vyvanse transfer restrictions yet."}, "asked_2": {"met": true, "why": "Agent asks for Maya and Eli's DOBs directly."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No recap of moved prescriptions given yet."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
